commits.name: Commit-0
commits.content:
pipeline_type: "two_stage"

data:
  csv_path: "../Datasets/scraped_blog_tables.csv"
  ohlc_dir: "../Datasets/OHLC data"
  output_dir: "../Datasets/VanilaDataset/X-Y Splitted Data"
  scrape:
    start_year: 2024
    end_year: 2024
    months: ["Jan", "Feb"]
  target_patterns: 
    - "Double Top, Adam and Adam"
    - "Triangle, symmetrical"
  max_samples_per_pattern: 5
  max_total_samples: 10

classifier:
  name: "minirocket"
  params:
    num_kernels: 100

localization:
  window_size: 30
  stride: 5
  eps_offset: 4
